summary: RetroShare is an open-source, decentralised communication system that provides peer-to-peer chat, forums, private messaging, and file transfer capabilities. It connects users directly through encrypted tunnels without relying on central servers. The project is implemented in C++ and distributed under the GPL-2.0 licence.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you require completely decentralised communication infrastructure that operates independently of third-party servers and central authorities.
watchOut: Development activity has slowed down over time, and the decentralised architecture typically requires both peers to be online to establish direct communication and transfers.
deployNotes: As a C++ application, you will typically need to manage persistent storage for your identity and data, and you may want to place it behind a reverse proxy depending on how you configure network access.
